name: Disney Conservation Fund grant opportunity

funder.name: The Walt Disney Company (Disney Conservation Fund)

summary: An annual two-year grant round for nonprofits protecting, connecting or restoring wildlife corridors and migratory pathways on land or water, with a separate smaller category for innovation. Applicants start with a short inquiry and selected ones are invited to a full proposal.
reporting: A final report due two years after the award (December 2028 for the 2026 round).

applicant_types.quote: Have US 501c3 organization status OR apply via a valid US 501c3 intermediary partner.

geography.quote: Through this opportunity, the fund seeks to support programs working to protect, connect, or restore critical sites globally.

access.quote: An invitation is not required to submit an inquiry, and submission of an inquiry is the first step to being considered for this grant opportunity.

window.quote: This will be our only open call for conservation-related funding proposals in 2026.

amount.quote: Protect, Connect, Restore grants with a request maximum of $150,000; and Innovation grants with a request maximum of $50,000.

reporting.quote: The grant term will be two years with a final report due two years after funding is awarded (December 2028).
